name: b-roll-split
title: B-roll Split
summary: Split layout: a clean browser window fills the top, you sit in the card below with your head breaking its edge. The address types itself in, the page loads on your word, then drifts slowly like a Ken Burns move.
keyMoment: the page loads into the browser window on the word: the progress bar sweeps and the picture lands with a small settle
